notes: 34 provincial-level units after Resolution 202/2025/QH15 (adopted 2025-06-12; new provincial governments from 2025-07-01). Now 25 tỉnh + 9 thành phố: Hà Nội, Hồ Chí Minh, Hải Phòng, Đà Nẵng, Cần Thơ, Huế (city from 2025-01-01), Đồng Nai (2026-04-30), Quảng Ninh (2026-09-01), Bắc Ninh (2026-09-20). ISO 3166-2:VN has not been updated and still lists all 63 old codes, so each unit keeps the ISO code of the old unit whose name survives and the 29 absorbed codes are aliases (they remain in ISO but no longer name a unit; never reuse them). VNPost upgraded its systems for the new boundaries on 2025-07-02 and accepts old and new addresses (converter at diachi.vnpost.vn); commune-level postcodes were amended by Decision 2334/QĐ-BKHCN (2025-08-24), province prefixes appear unchanged. If ISO later issues new codes for merged units, these must be revisited.
